attempts.surface: Unified task composer attachment UI and full-screen image preview via Electron CDP + Playwright
attempts.input: Attached round-preview-20261006.png through the in-app HTML input, inspected the thumbnail, then clicked 查看原图.
actual_steps: Created and validated a harmless 32×24 PNG fixture with no personal or operational data.
Added exactly one image to a clean round-owned unsent draft using the in-app file input.
Scoped to the image item component; observed img alt round-preview-20261006.png, natural size 32×24, a thumbnail button titled 查看原图, and a 移除图片 action.
Clicked the thumbnail. A full-screen viewer appeared with role=dialog, aria-modal=true, aria-label=原图预览, the same source image and a 关闭原图预览 control.
Closed the viewer and removed the one round-owned image attachment; confirmed the draft had zero image items.
attempts.wait_condition: Waited for image item and full-screen preview modal to render; then closed the modal and verified cleanup in the round-owned draft.

checkpoints.observed: The composer rendered a PNG thumbnail with alt text round-preview-20261006.png and natural dimensions 32×24.
Clicking the thumbnail opened a full-screen modal labeled 原图预览 with the same image and a close action.

attempts.observed_result: The harmless PNG appeared as an image thumbnail with filename and opened in the full-screen original-image preview. The viewer closed normally; the image was removed from the unsent draft afterward.
attempts.notes: A selector-scope diagnostic was corrected: image items use a different component from ordinary file cards. The corrected UI evidence is registered; earlier no-card queries are retained only as locator diagnostics and do not support a product failure. Pending bilateral review.

changes: Removed the only round-owned PNG attachment from the unsent draft after preview.
remaining: round-preview-20261006.png remains as a harmless task fixture.

product_observations.statement: A harmless 32×24 round-owned PNG rendered as a thumbnail with its filename; clicking 查看原图 opened the full-screen 原图预览 dialog. The modal closed and the draft image attachment was removed.
product_observations.verified_depth: Actual composer PNG thumbnail, filename alt text, full-screen preview modal and removal cleanup
product_observations.scope_and_limits: One tiny harmless round-owned PNG in an unsent draft. No message sent and no user file modified.
product_observations.relation_to_design: Pending bilateral review; scoped to the tested image item and preview path.
